corrections.text: The Implications section says that The Hacker News, like VentureBeat, reports research done by others, and names only GBHackers and Cyber Security News as restating it. The Hacker News's account of the Apiiro findings is also largely a relay of Apiiro's research write-up (it attributes the counts to what "its research write-up shows" and to "the researchers"), with cross-references to Claude Code's documentation but no independent test. The Herald did not read Apiiro's write-up: every Apiiro figure in the article, including the scanner results and the statements in the open questions, comes from The Hacker News or GBHackers, and none of the cited outlets independently reproduced Apiiro's counts.
